run_eval_cifar: run the CIFAR-10 adversarial evaluation script with FGSM attack on a pretrained model
run_fgsm_attack: run the Madry FGSM adversarial attack against the UAT CIFAR-10 model with configurable epsilon
build_dataset: build a TensorFlow dataset from raw NumPy image and label tensors with batching and shuffling
normalize_cifar_images: normalize CIFAR-10 images using channel-wise mean and standard deviation whitening for ResNets
compute_top1_accuracy: compute the top-1 classification accuracy from model logits and ground truth labels
